enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Unholy 6: On Hit: 6 to 36 Evil damage. Evil-aligned creatures are immune to this effect.Penalty: If equipped by a Good user, they receive 1 Negative Level for as long as this item is equipped.
Negative Blast 6: This weapon is an unholy conduit, dealing 6d6 Negative damage on a successful hit, and an additional 6d6 Negative damage on a critical hit.
Human Bane 6: This weapon is attuned specifically to hunt those with diversity and ambition, dealing an additional 6d10 bane damage vs. Humans.
Doublestrike 15%: Passive: 15% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
